notes: Resident population from Iran's 2016 census by official municipal district (mantaqeh) — genuine intra-city subdivisions. No real employment data exists: jobs are a flat 40% of resident population, redistributed across OSM buildings weighted by floor area only. Commute flows are an unconstrained gravity model with no real O/D anchor of any kind.
sources: amar.org.ir (Statistical Center of Iran), 2016 census by mantaqeh
